verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core 'Bases' plugin explicitly creates 'database-like views of your notes' from structured properties, and community reports confirm real use (e.g., organizing D&D campaign notes) with responsive dev support. However, Bases was still in beta and described by users as only a '90% replacement' for the more mature Dataview plugin, lacking full comprehensiveness, and no evidence details specific view types like boards/kanban being native. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of all view formats (table/board/list) with query examples, and evidence of post-beta stability/full feature parity.
